agent_runtimes_title: Connect to this machine's Persona node as an agent runtime
agent_runtimes_detail: Its program registers its own agents with the node on the hub machine, so they show up in Agents; in a sandbox it gets only one extra way out, to the node's runtime.sock, and sees no other files
runs_code_title: Run a program on the hub machine
runs_code_detail: Runs as the hub system user. By default, a sandbox allows access only to its own package and data directories. Extensions from trusted markets, or with their sandbox disabled by the owner, can access any files available to that user.
launcher_keys_title: Use launcher keys to access their gateways
launcher_keys_detail: Reads usage and draws panels on launcher pages and its own pages, such as sidebar usage. It never sees the key: the hub or the computer with that launcher sends requests on its behalf, only to that launcher’s gateway.
gh_login_title: Use the GitHub login from gh on your computer
gh_login_detail: Reads the gh login token from the computer you select, keeps it only in memory, and uses it to access GitHub.
usage_gateways_title: Read gateway account lists from usage sources (without keys)
usage_gateways_detail: Reads accounts, status, and usage from account-pool gateways configured in hub administration › Usage sources, using the hub’s last snapshot. It receives no management key.
hub_api_detail: Receives the hub’s full token and can do everything its owner can, including reading the knowledge base and controlling agents on your computers. New extensions should request only the scopes they need (permissions.hub).
node_files_title: Read and write files on these computers
node_files_detail: Not limited to its own data directory.
node_macos_privacy_detail: Permissions such as Full Disk Access and Accessibility require your approval on that Mac.
tools_detail: {tools}. Installed in the extension’s own directory without administrator privileges; compatible tools already on the machine are reused.
node_run_detail: {systems}; asks again when enabled on each computer. Runs as the node system user and can access any files available to that user, without a sandbox.
network_detail: {hosts} (only these hosts are reachable in a sandbox)
contributes_detail: Sends its manifest contributions to these extensions: {names}
channel_detail: Sends messages you address to it in {names} to Persona, then returns answers and agent questions to you.
sends_as_user_detail: Can send messages in your name on its own, without asking on your phone first ({names}). It reports what it sends and Persona keeps that in its record of what was sent as you; the hub cannot check a send it does not report.
recalls_sent_detail: Can take back messages it sent in your name ({names}), but only after you ask for a recall and confirm, and only within the time limit and while the other service still allows it. It cannot start a recall itself.
node_runs_code_title: Run a program on the computers you select
node_more_title: Run a program on more types of computers
node_network_title: Access the network from these computers
channel_title: Act as a channel for talking to Persona
recalls_sent_title: Take back messages it sent in your name
surfaces_title: Display its own UI inside the app
surfaces_external_title: Display its own UI inside and outside the app
host_integrations_title: Use the configured host CLI integration
host_integrations_detail: {tools}. Bounded, read-only calls through the manager; no shell access, message sending, or credential export.
channel_more_title: Act as additional channels for talking to Persona
sends_as_user_more_title: Send messages as you from more connectors
surfaces_more_title: Display its UI in more places in the app
node_secrets_more_title: Send more secrets to these computers
scope_sent_read: See which archived messages Persona sent as you
scope_inbox_write: Handle inbox items (mark done, draft and send replies, mute)
scope_agents_read: View agents and chats on your computers
scope_agents_control: Control agents (create, message, interrupt, answer questions, approve)
scope_agents_permission_mode: Change the permission mode of the chats it started itself
scope_assistant_ask: Start Persona chats and read chat activity
scope_assistant_read: Read your Persona chats (your messages and its replies)
scope_assistant_memory_read: Read what Persona remembers about you (read-only, never the health space)
scope_todos_write: Create and edit to-dos and link chats to them (no deletion)
scope_leaders_read: View leader conversations (directions) and what they report
scope_assistant_dispatch_policy: Read and change the assistant dispatch policy (which conversations may hand out work)
scope_models: Use the model you pick for it in Settings › Model configuration (never the key)
slot_capsule_card: Card in Android’s cross-app floating capsule (outside the app)
slot_machine_section: Section on computer details (receives the computer identity)
slot_inbox_item: Details of items from its connector in the inbox (receives the item title, summary, and tier)
slot_widget: Home screen widgets and watch complications (outside the app)
event_kb_changed: Knowledge base entries changed (type, ID, changed fields; requires knowledge base read access)
event_kb_forgotten: A source was removed from the knowledge base (source; requires knowledge base read access)
event_inbox_changed: Inbox items were added or updated (source, kind, title)
event_agent_needs_you: An agent is waiting for your answer or approval (computer, session, question)
event_todo_changed: A to-do was created, changed or deleted (title, chat thread; requires to-do read access)
event_todo_decision: A decision was recorded on a to-do (question, choice, source; requires to-do read access)
event_leader_changed: A leader conversation was made, renamed, filed under another project or ended (requires leader read access)
event_leader_report: A leader's task reached its goal, needs your decision or is stuck (requires leader read access)
error_reports_detail: Errors and crashes of the hub and your devices, scrubbed first: no message text, tokens, user names, machine names or IP addresses. It decides where they go (for example an error tracker)
auth_relay_title: Complete sign-in links for your Agents
auth_relay_detail: When an Agent on one of your computers stops at an authorization link it names (one its own command printed), it is handed the link and completes it with the account it is signed in with, so you are not asked. Other links still come to you
network_config_title: Reach the address you enter in its settings
network_config_detail: The address in the “{field}” setting (now: {host}): that one host and port only, https only
network_config_detail_http: The address in the “{field}” setting (now: {host}): that one host and port only; unencrypted http allowed
secret_provider_detail: When one of your settings holds a {schemes} reference, or you approve handing one to an Agent on the phone, Persona asks it for the value. It learns which reference is used and what for, never your other secrets
assistant_data_title: Add what it writes to what your assistant reads
assistant_data_detail: Text its program writes can go into the assistant's instructions and skills, an Agent's project background or Inbox triage and drafts, within size limits. You can switch each part off in its details
